title: Parchment (Lower City)
summary: Read to learn the password to Philgrave’s Mansion.

fields.Use: Say “Secreta Mortuorum” at the hidden entrance to Mystic Carrion’s mansion.
fields.Acquisition: On a crate in a Lower City alley near the Guildhall entrance, X 73, Y −107.
fields.Base value: 14 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
